g.text: Tokens set the cost; the context window sets the limit
a big window is a limit on what one call can read, not memory
1 token is about 4 characters,
or about three-quarters of a word.
1,000 tokens is about 750 words.
input and output billed separately
per million tokens; output often costs
more. Prices fall: date every quote.
context window: all input plus output in one call
system prompt
chat history
retrieved text
question
answer room
lost in the middle: facts here get missed
you pay for every input token
on every call: a long context
is a recurring cost
no memory between calls.
chat memory is history or saved
facts re-sent inside the window
quality can drop for facts buried
in the middle of a very long window
so test with real documents
prompts are product code: version them, test them, monitor them
